lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The air changes. Cold, sudden, precise — like stepping into the space between two thoughts.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: Crystal formations along the walls. Not natural. Too regular. Too clean.
lines.lens: The crystals are refracting light that isn't there. Each facet shows something different — a corridor, a skyline, a page of text. All of them real. None of them here.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: It's a shrine. Auryn's, I think.
lines.monologue: He doesn't know how he knows. The name arrived the way threshold markers do — already understood.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The shrine doesn't speak. It shows. A crystal near Zi's hand clears, and for a moment she sees through it: the ruins from above, mapped in perfect detail. Every corridor. Every collapsed passage. Every threat she hasn't found yet.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: I can see all of it. Every angle I've been calculating, laid out at once. This is what it would be like to see everything. It's beautiful. It's unbearable.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: The god of sight. Not just eyes — perception. Understanding. The kind that doesn't look away.
lines.monologue: He's writing in his notebook. His hand is shaking slightly. Not fear. Recognition.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The crystals dim. The shrine waits, patient as a clear sky.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Something is placed at the shrine's base. In return, a single crystal clears — and stays clear. A map fragment. A path not yet walked. Knowledge given for knowledge offered.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: I memorized it. Every line. I don't know what it leads to yet. But I will.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The cold recedes. The shrine dims. Whatever was here has turned its attention elsewhere — vast, indifferent, already looking at something a thousand miles away.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No one moves for a long moment. Then the cold recedes on its own, like a tide going out.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: The crystals are just stone now. But I can still feel it — that clarity. Like an afterimage.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The shrine dims behind them. It will wait here for the next person who comes looking, or the next hundred years. It makes no difference.
